source: Fixture for issue 470: package-global metrics collectors from the architecture review of a real triage run on a 15-file Go package (#468). Co-change counts come from an analogous file pair in another repo: last 200 non-merge commits, commits of 30 files or fewer.

candidates.claim: The metrics collectors are package globals, so counts leak from one test into the next, and no test asserts watchdog_withdrawals_total or watchdog_probes_total, which ADR 0003 pages and graphs on. Inject a metrics struct into NewProber.
The comment above the collectors says server.go registers them in init(); promauto registers them and there is no server.go.
